constraintsBody.intro: As you answer these questions, please think about what it would actually be like to do this work in a real workplace. Consider practical constraints such as:

items.label: Time pressure
items.detail: e.g., the presentation is due today

items.label: Professional relationships
items.detail: e.g., your relationship with your peer teammates

items.label: Team norms
items.detail: e.g., whether your team typically asks each other for help

constraintsBody.outro: …and what would feel feasible—not just what might seem ideal.

constraintsReminder: When answering, keep real-world workplace constraints in mind—such as time, professional relationships, team norms, and what would actually be feasible.
